formRaceEntries.commentStewards: Steadied at the start when tightened for room. Rider reported the gelding travelled well throughout however when asked from an effort failed to respond as expected, which he attributed to today's heavy track conditions. A post-race vet exam did not identify any significant abnormal findings. Trainer stated the gelding has now performed poorly on two occasions when racing on heavy tracks and it would now be his intention to continue with the preparation, however, avoid heavy tracks.
